# E5-LS1-T2 grounded source cards

## R01 — Hybrid working from home improves retention without damaging performance
- Source: Nature (2024)
- URL: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07500-2
- Type: randomized_controlled_trial
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Randomized field experiment at Trip.com showing hybrid work improved retention without harming performance.

## R02 — The Evolution of Working from Home
- Source: Stanford SIEPR (2023)
- URL: https://siepr.stanford.edu/publications/working-paper/evolution-working-home
- Type: working_paper
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Research synthesis arguing hybrid work is typically productivity-neutral while fully remote can be lower productivity.

## R03 — Remote Work, Employee Mix, and Performance
- Source: Stanford SIEPR (2025)
- URL: https://siepr.stanford.edu/publications/working-paper/remote-work-employee-mix-and-performance
- Type: working_paper
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Firm-level study of a Turkish call center showing fully remote employees with in-person onboarding had higher productivity.

## R04 — The Rise of Remote Work: Evidence on Productivity and Preferences from Firm and Worker Surveys
- Source: Harvard Business School (2025)
- URL: https://www.hbs.edu/faculty/Pages/item.aspx?num=66633
- Type: peer_reviewed_article
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Survey-based evidence on productivity perceptions and worker preferences about remote work.

## R05 — Measuring Work from Home
- Source: Stanford SIEPR (2025)
- URL: https://siepr.stanford.edu/publications/working-paper/measuring-work-home
- Type: working_paper
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Measurement paper harmonizing WFH survey estimates; evidence-heavy and explicit about survey design.

## R06 — Impacts of remote work on vehicle miles traveled and transit ridership in the USA
- Source: Nature Cities (2024)
- URL: https://www.nature.com/articles/s44284-024-00057-1
- Type: peer_reviewed_article
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Evidence about remote work's mobility impacts; relevant but not directly about productivity.

## R07 — Working from Home in 2025: Five Key Facts
- Source: Stanford SIEPR (2025)
- URL: https://siepr.stanford.edu/publications/essay/working-home-2025-five-key-facts
- Type: research_brief
- Evidence strength: medium
- Notes: Survey brief with explicit sample details for global WFH patterns.

## R08 — Remote Work Is The Future—Here's How To Integrate It
- Source: Forbes Technology Council (2024)
- URL: https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbestechcouncil/2024/03/28/remote-work-is-the-future-heres-how-to-integrate-it/
- Type: opinion_post
- Evidence strength: low
- Notes: Executive opinion piece advocating remote work with anecdotes and no formal methodology.

## R09 — The Secret To Retaining Top Talent: Why Remote Work Is Your Best Strategy For Long-Term Employee Satisfaction
- Source: Forbes Business Council (2024)
- URL: https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbesbusinesscouncil/2024/09/03/the-secret-to-retaining-top-talent-why-remote-work-is-your-best-strategy-for-long-term-employee-satisfaction/
- Type: opinion_post
- Evidence strength: low
- Notes: CEO opinion about remote work as retention strategy; anecdotal and advocacy oriented.

## R10 — Remote Work Doesn’t Boost Productivity In 2024—This Does
- Source: Forbes (2024)
- URL: https://www.forbes.com/sites/rachelwells/2024/11/05/remote-work-doesnt-boost-productivity-in-2024-this-does/
- Type: commentary
- Evidence strength: low
- Notes: Commentary article built around quoted experiences rather than a formal study.

## R11 — Former M&S boss says working from home is 'not doing proper work'
- Source: The Guardian (2025)
- URL: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2025/jan/20/working-from-home-not-doing-proper-work-stuart-rose
- Type: news_quote
- Evidence strength: low
- Notes: News article centered on a prominent executive's opinion that WFH harms productivity.

## R12 — The CEO 'return to office or else' is having limited success in 2024
- Source: CNBC (2024)
- URL: https://www.cnbc.com/2024/02/04/the-ceo-return-to-office-or-else-is-having-limited-success-this-year.html
- Type: news_analysis
- Evidence strength: medium
- Notes: Journalistic synthesis with some survey references, but a lot of narrative around CEO sentiment.
